name: video-shotcraft
tagline_zh: 把网页变成电影级产品片，不用剪辑。一张配方卡，自动运镜、卡点、配乐，连截图都真实。
tagline_en: Turn a webpage into a cinematic product video. One recipe card drives camera moves, beat-synced cuts, and sound.
desc_en: Create cinematic product videos from shot recipe cards, a validated template, and code/audio assets (Remotion + real page screenshots + 2.5D camera moves + beat-synced cuts + sound design). Use when the user asks to turn a frontend project or webpage into a product video, says "use video-shotcraft to make a video/promo", names the Ink Press template or asks to reproduce its effect, or wants a sing
why_zh: 同类靠模板拼凑，它用真实页面截图加2.5D运镜，节奏卡音乐，细节像手工调过。
why_en: Others stitch templates; this uses real screenshots with 2.5D moves and beat-synced cuts, so it feels art-directed, not.
